title: WitnessEntry
description: One tamper-evident link in a run's evidence chain. Each entry commits to its predecessor, so removal, reordering or rewriting is detectable by recomputation alone, without a trusted server.

seq.description: Position in the chain, starting at 1.

actor.description: Role id, service name, or 'captain' for a human decision.

event.description: Dotted event name, for example agent.started or gate.decided.

payload.description: Event body. Secrets are never written here; references only.

prev_digest.description: Digest of the previous entry, or 'genesis' for the first.
